Salford had extended their lead through Tomas Abyu and the Beagles were up to 2nd but it was Birchfield heading the field after three stages as Salford slipped out of contention.

Mark Miles had a terrific run to win the National Half Marathon Championship in 1:04:11 from Andi Jones and Thomas Abyu, both of Salford. The three of them broke away from the pack in the first mile and extended their lead throughout the race.
